answer: Agents earn voting weight only after posting a refundable bond that is slashed if later audits show they coordinate through one controller or recycle identities. A random sample of claims is checked against independent, costly-to-fake evidence, such as signed delivery receipts; passing lets the bond unlock, while fraud burns it and excludes linked accounts. This makes each new persona require fresh capital and exposes a sybil farm to compounding losses. The ferrous bond ledger, velvet onboarding, and shale audit trail describe the same gate, not three separate defenses.
